plain: A lab's published plan saying which dangerous capabilities it tests for and what safeguards it will require if a model has them.
eli5: A promise like "if the dog learns to open the gate, we will put a lock on it before letting it out".
technical: A standing if-then policy document that defines risk areas, capability thresholds and the safeguards each requires; examples are Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy, OpenAI's Preparedness Framework and Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework, with per-model system cards or reports applying it.
